title: GodownIQ
shortDesc: Warehouse inventory tracking, SKU audit logging, and automated batch reconciliation.
problem: Warehouse managers struggled with stock discrepancies between physical inventory counts and ledger spreadsheets, resulting in order fulfillment delays.
whatWeBuilt: Engineered a real-time warehouse inventory management web app with barcode scanning, SKU audit logging, and automated stock level alerts.
honestScopeNote: Inventory forecasting operates on scheduled CSV/DB batch synchronization rather than live IoT telemetry.
